verdict.rationale: Morph is an API-first service that runs programmatically without a UI. The docs show OpenAI-SDK access, a standby tier built for batch and background workloads, and job-based Reflex training you can poll. A community user confirms scripted use through a CLI tool. However, nothing documents running Morph in CI pipelines, so the CI half of the story is only implied by API access. missing for 10: documented CI pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or CI recipes), an official headless CLI or runner, and independent corroboration of CI automation use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1.
Built for batch and background workloads where a retry costs nothing.
Create a job, poll until it finishes, then classify text against it.
This uses an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so got this working with my llm.datasette.io CLI tool
